label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: J.T. Poston wins the Memorial
items.text: J.T. Poston won the Memorial Tournament presented by Workday after beating Ryan Gerard on the second playoff hole.

items.headline: Nelly Korda wins the U.S. Women’s Open
items.text: Nelly Korda won the U.S. Women’s Open at Riviera, using a late birdie on No. 17 to claim her first U.S. Women’s Open title.

items.headline: Rory and Scottie scout Shinnecock
items.text: Rory McIlroy and Scottie Scheffler have already seen Shinnecock Hills ahead of the U.S. Open. The early read: wider fairways than expected, but heavy rough and difficult greens make missed fairways expensive.
